# User is (`user`)

**Kind:** condition · **Category:** Context · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

True when the user involved is one of the listed users. In machine automations this is the user from the event (who signed in or started the app); in personal automations it is you.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `users` | user or list of users | yes |  | User names, DOMAIN\name, SIDs or wildcards. |

## Example

```yaml
conditions:
  - type: user
    users: [samet, guest*]
```
